Method of Attack: Memory corruption leading to remote code execution
Execution of arbitrary commands via OLE objects
Launching executable files from WebDAV server
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Office (all versions released in the past 17 years, including Office 365)
Windows operating system (including Windows 10 Creators Update)
Attack Vector: Opening a specially crafted malicious file
Combining with Windows Kernel privilege escalation exploits (e.g., CVE-2017-11847)
